decisions.reason: The net price display plugin sits within the firm's core shop-extension knowledge and is cheap to maintain, although its absence from the website in 2020-2021 suggests it may have lost visibility during platform version changes.
ERP integration draws directly on the firm's integration expertise and recurring client needs, so its own development capacity makes it worth adapting rather than dropping.

Two sibling price-comparison tracking plugins were already pruned and this one has not appeared on the website since 2018, so the firm's learning points to limited value and the resources are better spent on core optimization work.
Net price reporting complements the display plugin on the same knowledge base, but its missing web presence makes it a likely candidate for consolidation.
